thread.title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! • Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu. - Episode 8 discussion

opinions.point: The dominant reaction was that the episode was exceptionally cute, romantic, and emotionally satisfying.
Many commenters praised the leads' chemistry, especially the male lead's caring behavior and increasingly open affection.
Viewers enjoyed the heroine's expressive, easily flustered reactions and found her especially charming.
Several commenters felt this was among the strongest romance episodes of the season, with some calling it the show's best so far.
The episode's gentle humor and romantic tension were widely appreciated.
The town guards were repeatedly criticized as irritating, rude, or sexist.
A few reactions were uneasy about how severe and painful the episode's magical consequences appeared, even while finding the idea interesting.
Some viewers noted that the story is relatively light and dialogue-driven, though they considered that appropriate for the show's strengths.
